sentences.en: You are mistaken: he plays double bass, not trombone.
sentences.zh: 你错了：他弹的是大提低音提琴，不是长号。

sentences.en: I play bass guitar in a guitar ensemble.
sentences.zh: 我在一个吉他乐团里演奏电贝斯。

sentences.en: Are you happy with your new bass guitar?
sentences.zh: 你觉得你的新电贝斯满意吗？

senses.zh: （音乐、乐器、声乐等的）低音，低音部；男低音；男低音歌手；低音电吉他（同 bass guitar）；低音提琴（同 double bass）；鲈鱼
